settings.editor: Exterior painting and staining built for intense sun, dry air and hard winters, through the Vail, Roaring Fork and Grand valleys.

settings.title: A finish that holds up at altitude

settings.editor:
Mountain sun breaks down coatings faster than almost anywhere else. We don't skimp on materials or surface preparation, and we follow each manufacturer's recommendations so your finish looks good and lasts.

Not sure about color? We'll help you choose, taking the light, the setting and the weather into account. A dedicated project lead oversees the work from start to finish.

• Siding, trim, fascia, doors and garage doors
  • Masking and protection of everything around the work
  • Spraying with back-brushing for a proper bond
  • Color consultation
  • Daily cleanup, with nothing left behind
We look at the work in person, talk through colors and products, and give you a clear written estimate with no hidden charges.
Floors, furnishings, fixtures and landscaping are covered. Surfaces are cleaned, repaired and prepped to the manufacturer's specifications.
Premium coatings applied the right way, with enough coats for our dry, high-altitude climate. When we spray, we back-brush for a proper bond.
We clean up every day, then walk the finished job with you before we call it done. Your project lead is your contact the whole way.
